{"id":1826045052,"question_id":3834,"lang":"cpp","lang_name":"C++","time":"8 months, 1 week","timestamp":1762785311,"status":11,"status_display":"Wrong Answer","runtime":"N/A","url":"/submissions/detail/1826045052/","is_pending":"Not Pending","title":"Minimum Operations to Convert All Elements to Zero","memory":"N/A","code":"class Solution {\npublic:\n    int minOperations(vector<int>& nums) {\n        stack<int>st;\n        unordered_set<int>set;\n        int opr = 1;\n\n        if(nums.size() > 1 and (nums[0] == 0 or nums[1] == 0)) return 1;\n        if(nums.size() == 1 and nums[0] == 0) return 0;\n\n        st.push(nums[0]);\n        set.insert(nums[0]);\n        for(int i=1 ; i<nums.size() ; i++)\n        {\n            if(st.top() <= nums[i] && !set.count(nums[i]))\n            {\n                st.push(nums[i]);\n                set.insert(nums[i]);\n                opr++;\n            }\n            if(st.top() > nums[i] && set.count(nums[i]))\n            {\n                int top = st.top();\n                st.pop();\n                set.erase(top);\n            }\n            if(st.top() > nums[i] && !set.count(nums[i]))\n            {\n                st.push(nums[i]);\n                set.insert(nums[i]);\n                opr++;\n            }\n        }\n    return opr;\n    }\n};","compare_result":"","title_slug":"minimum-operations-to-convert-all-elements-to-zero","has_notes":false,"flag_type":1,"frontend_id":1106}
